title: BestConfigHeadRefusal
description: Closed error envelope of the content-less agent-head read (GET /api/v1/best-configs/agent-heads/by-ref/{agent_ref}: every 4xx/5xx it can return except 429) and the closed refusal envelope of the PROTECTED best-config publish (POST /api/v1/best-configs, see that route's decision table). Same members as the generic error envelope but closed: `error_code` is one of the codes below, `error` and `message` are the fixed text for that code, and nothing of the request (ref value, ids, environment, generation, headers) is echoed. `reference_not_found` is the Backend's existing identity-ref refusal (an unknown, foreign, no-longer-visible or unreadable ref are indistinguishable). A refused protected publish writes no publication row and moves no head. The legacy publish keeps its own bodies (including STALE_HEAD_GENERATION) unchanged, and legacy consumers of the generic error envelope are untouched. Precedence when several apply is fixed by the route that returns the envelope: authentication and permissions first (unauthenticated, forbidden), then malformed syntax (head_capture_invalid, 400), then a well-formed but unknown or foreign ref (reference_not_found, 404), then authorization (head_write_unauthorized), then session agreement (head_agent_mismatch, head_environment_mismatch), then the publish body (head_body_invalid, 400: any validation failure of the request body, with fixed text and no echo of keys or values), then the head compare (head_generation_stale), then the ordinary publish conflict (head_publish_conflict, 409: If-Match on a new configuration, a changed existing configuration without a matching If-Match, or a function_ref conflict). A protected request never receives the generic BEST_CONFIG_CONFLICT or free-text validation bodies.

error.description: Fixed broad error name for the code.

error_code.description: reference_not_found (404): agent_ref well-formed but unknown, foreign, not visible or not readable. head_capture_invalid (400): malformed syntax (a ref or generation that does not match its pattern or type, a ref sent without a generation, both X-Traigent-Agent-Ref and X-Traigent-Agent-Id), a protected publish whose session binding cannot be resolved, or an `environment` query value outside the closed enum. head_environment_mismatch (409): the publish environment differs from the session's recorded environment. head_agent_mismatch (409): the ref's agent is not the agent the session binding resolves. head_generation_stale (409): the head moved since the run captured its generation. NORMATIVE: a stale refusal means the run's RESULT is stale. The client MUST NOT refresh the generation and resubmit the same result, and the SDK MUST NEVER auto-retry a stale refusal; it starts a new run, or re-evaluates against the new head, and then publishes with that run's own captured generation. head_write_unauthorized (403): the caller lacks agent WRITE authorization. head_body_invalid (400): the protected publish body failed validation (fixed text; the response never contains a key or value of the request). head_publish_conflict (409): the ordinary publish precondition failed on a protected request (If-Match on a new configuration, a changed existing configuration without a matching If-Match, or a function_ref conflict); the generic BEST_CONFIG_CONFLICT body is for the legacy path only. A protected publish that fails server-side returns internal_error (500) with fixed text. unauthenticated (401), forbidden (403), internal_error (500): the read route's closed authentication, permission and server errors.
